newsitem.title: USA: Michael Baker unit wins Iowa contract.
newsitem.headline: Michael Baker unit wins Iowa contract.

text.p: Michael Baker Corp's Baker Support Services Inc unit on Thursday said it received a contract with a potential value of $32.2 million to provide fleet management and maintenance services to the city of Des Moines, Iowa.
Work on the contract began July 1 and will continue through the year 2001 under its initial term. The contract then has two three-year option periods.
Baker Support will provide fleet-management services to the city's 1,700 vehicles and pieces of equipment. It will supply the city with more than 40 employees assigned to a variety of duties.

Specific tasks will include preventative maintenance, repairs, parts purchasing and inventory, emergency support services, vehicle preparation, overhaul, mobile service, towing, tire service, motor pool operations, fleet management, vehicle fueling and other allied services.
